summary: Iteration 15 regression on iteration 15 UI changes: ROI calculator redesign, Pricing page redesign + CurrencyToggle, and refreshed 3D scenes. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS (SEO, waitlist, careers, contact, admin JWT + jobs CRUD, dynamic careers). Frontend @1440: (1) ROI calculator math exact — defaults clients=8/hours=3/reports=2 → monthly 48 h / annual 576 h / workdays 43 / saved 230 h; sliders moved to clients=20, hours=5, reports=4 → monthly 400 / annual 4,800 h / workdays 360 / saved 1,920 h (matches clients*hours*reports*12 and 40% reduction). Reduction slider → donut percentage AND YOU marker left% both update correctly: reduction=60 ⇒ donut 60% / marker left:40%; reduction=10 ⇒ donut 10% / marker left:90%. (2) Copy result button (roi-copy-result) swaps icon+label to 'Copied' immediately on click and reverts to 'Copy result' after ~2s. (3) Pricing page CurrencyToggle: Starter mask text toggles $•• ↔ ₹ •,••• and Growth $••• ↔ ₹ ••,•••; toggle back to USD restores $••. (4) Pricing plan CTAs open waitlist modal with correct preselect — pricing-page-card-starter-cta ⇒ waitlist-interest-select='Starter', pricing-page-card-growth-cta ⇒ 'Growth'. (5) pricing-page-cta-button opens waitlist (interest defaults to 'Not sure yet', expected since no interest passed). (6) Waitlist smoke POST succeeded — modal shows 'You're on the list.' + 'Signup confirmed'. (7) 'Contact the team' link navigates to /contact. (8) Home 3D scenes: only 1 shared <canvas>; features section renders three 404x300 regions (feature-visual-inputs/-summaries/-delivery) with visually distinct compositions — Card 1 radial hub with 3 brand tiles + '3 → 1 sources · one schema' chip + report doc output, Card 2 drafting composition with source tiles → AI engine → June summary doc + chips 'AI · drafting summary···' / '+24% channel results' / 'Meta Ads · ROAS 2.4x'. Platform panel (platform-cloud-3d, 607x652) shows hub + 3 brand tiles + both restored KPI chips readable ('2.4x · ROAS · June' and '+38% conversions'), NOT clipped at panel edges. Calculator section renders dark hero card + 4 right-column cards (dark panel, yearly toll, With Fluxvex donut, Where you land bar). (9) 0 pageerrors and 0 significant console errors across home and pricing (THREE.Clock/WebGL warnings filtered per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: RoiCalculator.jsx copyResult correctly guards navigator.clipboard with window.isSecureContext and falls back to a hidden textarea + execCommand('copy') — the visible 'Copied' pill fires regardless, which matches the AC.

ReductionDonut uses framer-motion spring on strokeDashoffset while the YOU marker uses CSS transition on left% — both update smoothly without jank; 100-reduction mapping (left:${100-reduction}%) matches the comparison bar semantic (lower reduction = closer to 100% manual).

Pricing.jsx LockedPrice masks per-currency text live inside the DOM (not a background-image), so screen readers / tests can diff by text while the blur-[7px] filter keeps it visually locked — good a11y/testing trade-off.

PagePlanCard passes { interest: 'Starter'|'Growth' } through openWaitlist(source, overrides); WaitlistContext stores it in state and threads to WaitlistForm's initial form.interest — preselect verified end-to-end.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For next regression on this app: (1) ROI slider math holds exact (monthly=c*h*r, saved=round(annual*reduction/100), workdays=round((annual-saved)/8)); (2) roi-you-marker.style.left must equal `${100-reduction}%`; (3) roi-copy-result toggles 'Copy result' ↔ 'Copied' for ~2s; (4) pricing-page-card-{starter|growth}-cta must preselect waitlist-interest-select to 'Starter'/'Growth'; (5) features section renders one shared <canvas> and three 405x300 feature-visual-* regions with the radial hub (card 1) and drafting doc (card 2) visually distinct; (6) platform-cloud-3d (~607x652 @1440) keeps both KPI chips inside bounds. The waitlist success modal uses a curly apostrophe in 'You're on the list.' — don't text-match a straight apostrophe.
